Section.Title: A browser-hosted World
Section.Paragraph: This page runs Sia.NET and C# in WebAssembly. A script writes text to Output and sends values to Render.

Section.Title: 1. Create an entity
Section.Paragraph: Create an entity with a Message component. The World stores it for the rest of this scope.

Section.Title: 2. Share a scope
Section.Paragraph: Cells with the same scope compile and run in order. Later cells can use types and entities created earlier.

Section.Title: 3. Run in isolation
Section.Paragraph: A cell without a scope gets an independent World. Nothing from the scoped cells is carried into it.

Section.Title: 4. Split the source
Section.Paragraph: One cell can contain several named scripts. Model defines the data, Score contains the logic, and Report produces the result.
